preparation_cost.scope: Preparation only, same release unit binary and same authored input map for committed/live arms; five fresh processes, 240 rows/200 scored/40 warm. Alternating per-iteration arm order, warm filesystem/cache state. Timers separately cover capture, prepare, verify, disposal and total; live performs additional materializations/verification. No guest or Stage payload execution. Outer receipt CPU is wait4-observed/propagated usage; RSS is the largest individual waited-process peak with completed-wait propagation, not simultaneous process-tree memory or per-arm attribution. The outer workload includes fixture creation, executable hashing, assertions, report writing, disposal and shell; no per-stage allocations, inner CPU/RSS, cold-cache, speedup or agent benefit claim. Outputs use shell-PID filenames and create_new; collision fails without overwrite. The native recorder supervises each sample at 90 s based on the separately observed 37.02 s debug smoke; there is no hard whole-recorder deadline. Setup/hash/publication work remains cooperative; the coordinating exec session must stay awaited. Interruption cannot establish complete cleanup and leaves unknown accounting. This unit fixture launches no guest and does not fork. Source/input/executable hash integrity is not producer authentication.
